d:
A shocking incident has been reported from a school in Panchkula, Haryana.
A Class 3 student allegedly attacked a KG girl with stones and a flower pot.
The child was also reportedly beaten and dragged inside the school premises.
She suffered serious injuries and was referred to PGIMER Chandigarh for treatment.
Police are investigating the reason behind the attack and the school’s security arrangements.
